description: Convert text to speech with a selected voice_id (see list_voices). Costs ceil(characters / 20) credits, minimum 1. Speech renders synchronously: the result usually returns immediately with output_urls.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, 1-200 visible ASCII characters without spaces. Reuse the same key when retrying after a timeout; a repeated key returns the original task and is not charged again.

name: generate_speech
